'''Dractuvian caveworms''' were six-legged tubular creatures with sharp teeth. They lived in the caves of the planet [[Dractu]]. One of them attached itself to [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who could not remove it without the assistance of a native [[Dractuvian]].

==Description==
A small tubular creature that lived in dark [[Cave/Legends|caves]]. This species had six tiny hook-like [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], three pairs of black dot-like [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and most notably, a round, saliva-dripping, toothed mouth with which the caveworm could firmly latch onto the flesh of other creatures. They were often found near groups of harmless [[Dractuvian cave slug|slugs]] and sometimes crawled into the burrows that dotted the cave walls.<ref name="CWA" />

==History==
[[File:LeechBite.jpg|left|thumb|300px|A cave leech bit Dexter Jettster]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] visited [[Dractu]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CWA" /> in the [[Mid Rim]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in search of a local cave slug, which he believed was considered a delicacy. Dexter, accompanied by a [[Unidentified Dractuvian warrior|guide]], reached the habitat of the creature he was searching for. Unaware of the existence of the caveworms, the Besalisk blindly stuck his hand into a burrow and immediately paid for his haste. The worm's gripping [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] latched onto Dexter's chin, and the guide had to help remove the creature: he grabbed the caveworm, braced both feet against the Besalisk's stomach, and pulled it away with all his strength. The animal's jaws could not withstand the force, and both travelers fell onto their backs. A reddened mark remained at the site of the bite, which Dexter later covered with a bandage after returning to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CWA" />
